_readme: Homepage Star Citizen hub status tiles (the Star Citizen Hub section under the pinned hub row; the split SC/GTA homepage was removed Nov 25, 2026). Edit values here, nothing else. Each tile: value (bold line), note (small line, use event dates like 'live since Nov 12', never 'as of'), url (primary source, linked from the tile). Bump 'checked' to today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) whenever you verify the tiles against RSI. Update when: a patch goes Live or to PTU, an event starts or ends, or CIG gives a new date. Feature block (starCitizenFeature, NOT shown on the homepage since Nov 25, 2026; kept for reuse): kicker = small line above the headline; countdownTo = ISO UTC time of the next officially dated SC event (set to null to hide the countdown); countdownLabel = text after the timer; doneText/doneLabel = shown once the time passes; links = button row (first link is the orange button). When IAE ends, replace the kicker/countdown with the next officially dated event or set countdownTo to null.
